snippet.title: Stickplosion — Gameplay Demo Reel (v0.6.8)
snippet.description:
Stickplosion is a fast, chaotic 2D PvP brawler with fully destructible terrain — blast the arena apart and use the rubble as your weapon.

This reel runs through the core modes and arenas:
• Mayhem — free-for-all carnage
• Duel — tense 1v1 standoffs
• FFA — every stick for themselves
• Destruction showcases — watch the terrain come apart

Arenas featured: Jungle Ruins, Urban Rooftops, Volcano Chambers, Space Station, Tower Climb, Sniper Alley, Cargo Bay, and Classic Platformer — plus the Card modifier system that remixes every match.

🎮 Wishlist & play on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4834640/
🌐 Learn more: https://stickplosion.ghostworldgaming.com

A Ghost World Gaming title.
